sections.text:
Work 
 order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category
Wear safety helmet, safety show, and safety belt
Switch off transformer from tow sides

items:
Measure the Noise Level and Vibration for the cooling fan. Be sure that it
 does not exceed the standard levels (40-60 dB in industrial workshop). Fix
 any problem to prevent the noise pollution. 'For any question refer back to
 the manufacturer.
Suitable tool sets
Vacuum cleaner or blower
Brush, Pieces of soft cloths
Suitable grease

Repeat steps of 3- Month inspection according to MPIS 
 document No. T-045-r0

Inspect external surface of transformer, possible rust 
 damages are removed, use primer and finish-paints
Inspect joints, retighten
Check oil seals, treat any oil leakage if exist

Inspect bushings, and check if there are unseen cracks in 
 porcelain, current traces, and oil leakage
Check oil level in bushings
Retighten bushing belts and screws

Inspect the arc - horn, retighten its tow arms, and check distance between the 
 tow parts

Check fan functions, clean operating box, clean contactors with video cleaner, 
 also inspect and clean heater, inspect also the gasket
Lubricate fan motors bearings
Check oil dielectric strength
Check oil moisture content
Check chemical analysis in insulation oil
Check gas analysis in insulation oil

Check the dielectric loss tangent (tg Õ) for 
 winding insulation
Check D.C. resistance at all tap-changer steps

Check transformation - ratio at all steps for the 
 three phases
Check R 60 and R 15 for winding

Inspect control cabinet of tap - changer to 
 discover eventual damages

Inspect auxiliary instruments (relays, 
 contactors, limit switch, etc ...) in operating box of tap-changer and clean 
 them with video cleaner

Inspect the condition of grease in the power 
 transmission box for tap-changer, add new grease if necessary

Check movement of arms engaged with power 
 transmission box for tap-changer

Check steps of tap-changer by changing steps from 
 step 1 to step 17 and vise-versa, this helps also for cleaning contacts

Check the heater and clean vents and filters in 
 tap-changer motor-dive mechanism cubicle

Check the interlocking contact in control circuit 
 to prevent electrical operation during manual operation
Check mechanical end stops

Read the counting device to determine when 
 overhaul is due

Inspect and clean the auxiliary current 
 transformer for winding temperature indicator (it is at the S phase 
 bushing at 22 kv side)

Check buchhulz relay float and contacts action 
 and check the SIGNAL and TRIP function of the relay by pressing on the 
 push-button (which occurred on the cover of buchholz relay and used for 
 mechanical test of the circuit), firstly pusf gently on the push - button 
 until signal happen, then continue pushing until tripping of transformer 
 circuit breaker at the tow sides

Inspect the contacts of the thermometer for oil 
 temperature
Check function of winding temperature indicator

Manually actuate oil temperature thermometer 
 contacts to check if it gives signals, trips or not

Manually actuate the contacts of thermometer of 
 ventilation system temperature control

Inspect thermometer pockets, the presence of 
 required quantity of oil in pockets

Check correct installation of active elements of 
 thermometers

Inspect the earthing resistance, clean its 
 components, clean and grease its contacts, retighten bolts and screws

Inspect and clean the current transformer and 
 lightning arresater of earthing resistance switch
Inspect the earthing system
Inspect silica-gel in the breather, change it if necessary

Inspect oil in breather, quantity and condition, it is 
 preferable to change it

Provision should be made for pressure relief device, 
 manually actuate the device by movement of valve disk and then reset it 
 manually by its arm, also proper clearance of the operating indicator should 
 be done.
